guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Outlook
section: (assumes an average foreign exchange rate of US$1=C$1.38)
Telesat is reiterating its 2026 GEO segment guidance provided in March:
● | GEO revenue to be between $300 million and $320 million;
● | GEO Adjusted EBITDA1 to be between $210 million and $230 million, excluding non-recurring debt refinancing costs.
Telesat is adjusting its Telesat Lightspeed spending forecast to reflect the expected timing of satellite and launch payments:

● | Total spending on the Telesat Lightspeed program, including both expensed and capitalized costs, is now expected to be in the $1.1 billion to $1.3 billion range, compared to the $1.3 billion to $1.5 billion range we provided when we reported second quarter 2026 earnings.

Telesat’s quarterly report on Form 6-K for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, has been filed with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and the Canadian securities regulatory authorities, and may be accessed on the SEC’s website at www.sec.gov and on the System for Electronic Document Analysis and Retrieval+ (SEDAR+) website at www.sedarplus.ca.
